classifiedMeaningOfCEA: In these packs, CEA document titles/bodies are controlled centre practical assessment tasks: APPRENTICE INSTRUCTIONS + APPRENTICE ASSESSMENT RECORD with Pass/Refer and assessor sign-off. Numbering follows Group.task (e.g. CEA 3.1 under Wheels and Tyres). Not workplace job cards; not Block Task 1/2 PDFs.
